facts.value: The University Computing Center (HRZ) provides students with the necessary IT for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). Additionally, it offers advice and support for technical problems.
The telephone hotline of Goethe University helps with questions regarding applications, semester dates, re-registration, subject changes, dual studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.

International Student Services provides international students with information on topics such as residence permits, German courses, financing, successful studying, careers, and more. It also offers consultation and support.

The Student Union supports students in social and economic matters. It aims to ensure that students at universities have the necessary infrastructure to study successfully in areas such as educational funding and student housing, as well as in cafeterias and counseling services.
